_comment: Transcribed from the sensor's calibration certificate at commissioning.
The serial and date are here so a stale or swapped sensor is visible in
the agent's start-up report. Every number is a transcription, and a
transcription error produces a plausible wrong answer.
THESE ARE PLACEHOLDER VALUES from the TE 8911 datasheet, not from a
certificate for a specific unit. Replace them before the data means
anything -- the nominal sensitivity of a 100 mV/g sensor is typically
within 5 % of the certified value, which is a 5 % amplitude error on
every reading and enough to move an ISO zone boundary.
